thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Autoscaler error + GPU pool exhaustion in us-west2. queue_length for inference-service-qa spiked to 18k, 95th latency > 10s, throttling engaged. Trigger: autoscaler.max_retries_exceeded. thread_ts=1839500000

maria (on-call): I'm paged, joining. investigating now — checking pool health and autoscaler logs.

samir: I'm seeing a ton of preempt events in the spot pool: 12 preemptions in the last 6m. KV-cache warmup causing backlog.

maria (on-call): Confirmed. GPU pool 'spot-n1-gpu' at 100% and cloud quota shows 0 available GPUs. Autoscaler attempted scale but hit cluster-node-limit.

ron (on-call-2): Copy. Any customer-facing impact?

maria (on-call): Yes, ~14% of requests are being throttled (429) and we have degraded throughput for Dedicated customers on us-west2. Product teams might see errors in consumer dashboards.

helen (product): Which customers are affected? Need list for comms.

maria (on-call): Pulling list from routing logs. Preliminary: 3 high-volume tenants (acme, fintech-alpha, media-x). Will attach once I have exact request IDs.

irene: Can we fallback to cpu-backed instances or smaller models automatically? What's the quick toggle?

samir: We have model-variants ready: quantized-cpu and small-lm-2 for graceful degradation, but dynamic routing requires enough compute. If we shift all some traffic, latency will increase but avoid errors.

maria (on-call): Plan proposal: 1) Pause autoscaler retries to avoid thrash (set autoscaler.retry_interval to 300s), 2) Temporarily flip routing for non-SLA tenants to quantized-cpu, 3) Open support ticket with cloud to request emergency GPU quota bump, 4) Enable surge on Dedicated pool if possible.

ron (on-call-2): I'm taking the handoff in 15m. Maria, please document current state in #incidents and paste the commands you ran.

maria (on-call): Commands I ran so far:
```
# check node counts
kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true -o wide
# autoscaler logs
gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_cluster AND jsonPayload.component=autoscaler" --limit 200
# current queue depth
redis-cli LLEN inference-queue:us-west2
```

samir: Also seeing a pattern: when spot preempts > 8 in 1m autoscaler fails to reconcile because controller backoff is tripped. We'll need to untangle backoff logic post-incident.

incident-bot: note: high-priority page created, incident severity P1. PagerDuty link: https://pd/re/INC-9812

helen (product): I'll prepare an internal note for the account teams. Hold communications until we know timeframe.

maria (on-call): Update: cloud support replied, asking for exact quota request details. Opening ticket with payload: request +20 GPUs for 2 hours in us-west2, project-id=redwood-prod. gcp-support-bot: any ETA?

gcp-support-bot: Support acknowledges; best-effort 45-90 minutes depending on regional capacity. Recommended alternative: move some traffic to us-east1 where GPUs available.

ron (on-call-2): I'm live now. Maria, handoff: current mitigation steps in progress?

maria (on-call): Handoff summary: 1) throttling observed, 2) quantized-cpu routes enabled for non-SLA (partial rollout via feature-flag), 3) autoscaler retry interval bumped to 300s to reduce churn, 4) quota request opened with cloud, 5) added temporary horizontal scaling cap override for Dedicated pool (if cloud grant). Logs and diffs in /var/tmp/incidents/1839500000.log.

ron (on-call-2): OK taking lead. Immediate actions I will perform: a) Initiate cross-region reroute for low-priority traffic to us-east1 (gradual 10% steps) b) Reduce concurrency per instance for us-west2 pool to conserve GPU memory c) Monitor queue length and 95th latency.

samir: For (b) you can run:
```
curl -X POST $ROUTER_API/update -d '{"pool":"us-west2","concurrency":32}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN"
```

ron (on-call-2): Running concurrency change now. Pushed 32 -> confirmed. Monitoring.

irene: Any chance to fall back to on-prem cluster for a subset of traffic? That requires network path and auth changes, might be slow.

ron (on-call-2): Not for immediate relief, too many manual steps. Focus on cross-region and model variance first.

incident-bot: metric alert cleared: queue_length dropped from 18k to 6.2k after routing change. latency 95th now ~4.8s and trending down.

ron (on-call-2): Good. Keep increments and watch for more preempts. If we see repeated preempt bursts, we may need to disable spots and move to on-demand for one pool. That will cost more but stabilizes.

maria (on-call): Noting customer impact: Acme saw transient 503s for 7m window earlier, fintech-alpha had some failed requests on retries. Will compile error counts by tenant and severity.

helen (product): Please add impact summary: number of affected requests per customer, duration, and any SLA breaches. We'll coordinate support comms.

samir: Post-incident action items I'm logging: 1) autoscaler backoff should be adaptive to preempt rate, 2) add proactive cross-region failover policy when spot preempt rate > X, 3) pre-warm tiny on-demand buffer for high-priority tenants.

ron (on-call-2): I'll keep monitoring for the next hour and then start incident bridge notes for postmortem. Handoff to oncall-2 complete unless escalations.

maria (on-call): Thanks team. If quota comes through, we can scale Dedicated and rollback routing. Keep me looped.

incident-bot: incident P1 -> downgraded to P2 pending stabilization. Time to acknowledge: 00:28:44.

ron (on-call-2): Closing thread for now, will reopen if metrics regress.
